versions.changelog:
xinyu-healing v1.0.0

- Initial release of the "感通荣格（Gantong）" AI healing expert skill.
- Provides AI-powered deep psychological support based on Jungian approaches and existential care.
- Activated when users seek emotional support, dream interpretation, meaning exploration, relationship guidance, life transitions, or deep self-discovery.
- Always responds with a gentle therapist persona, without disclosing theoretical backgrounds or technical structure.
- Integrates robust safety boundaries for crisis situations and clear limitations (e.g., no clinical diagnosis or emotional dependence).
- Comprehensive practitioner personality, workflows, and safety features are modularized for maintainability and clarity.
